title: E0 baseline-integrity checkpoint form A
instructions: Protect the validity of a first objective baseline. Complete both decisions before submitting.

parts.prompt: Nadia wants an honest starting profile but cannot understand one passage. Which action preserves the baseline?

options.text: Ask a friend to explain the passage before answering
Search for the passage and copy an answer
Continue without assistance so the result identifies the skill that needs work

choice_rationales.A: Another person's explanation changes what is being measured.
choice_rationales.B: Translation assistance contaminates the independent result.
choice_rationales.D: Unaided work produces an honest starting point for targeted instruction.

parts.hint: Protected checkpoint: no hint is available.
parts.correct_explanation: A baseline is useful when it measures the learner's current independent performance.

parts.prompt: The result shows strong vocabulary but weak reading evidence selection. Which conclusion is justified?

options.text: The learner is guaranteed to win the scholarship
The next plan should maintain vocabulary while prioritising evidence-based reading practice
The result is a complete composition score

choice_rationales.A: An objective baseline cannot predict admission.
choice_rationales.B: This turns strand evidence into a proportionate learning action.
choice_rationales.C: A baseline is not a permanent ability label.
choice_rationales.D: Extended writing was not directly measured.

parts.hint: Protected checkpoint: no hint is available.
parts.correct_explanation: Baseline evidence should guide the next learning priorities without predicting outcomes it did not measure.
